initial_application: No explicit FHIR-6260-tagged source commit was found. Git history shows source/observation/observation-genetics-introduction.xml gained a Genetic Standards and Resources section listing dbSNP, ClinVar, COSMIC, RefSeq, ENSEMBL, HGNC, HGVS, Sequence Ontology, and LOINC, and that material was carried in the old Observation genetics profile source.
additional_context: The old Observation genetics profile was later deliberately removed from core in commit 3cfe12f1b4037e4fe922af288ba96fa49faf1435 as part of removing outdated clinical genomics artifacts. Current source/fhir.ini has no observation-genetics profile entry; Observation remains active, MolecularSequence is commented out, and MolecularDefinition is active for Clinical Genomics. Current Observation notes and the Genomics page link to the Genomics Reporting Implementation Guide for detailed genomic reporting guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current core source edit is appropriate because reintroducing the retired DSTU1 standards/resources list would revive out-of-build content and duplicate current Clinical Genomics guidance.
